The Truth About $GTA (2wMTr4ZttVr5tmS4wLStee59wi8f9QQfMtT2Hoispump)

$GTA is a Solana memecoin launched on @Pumpfun in early-to-mid August 2026 (roughly 2.5 months old as of late October). The contract is 2wMTr4ZttVr5tmS4wLStee59wi8f9QQfMtT2Hoispump and the token is named Grand Theft Auto.

Unlike most pure narrative GTA tokens that appeared later, this one has a real and ongoing connection to Mike Dailly (@mdf200), one of the original creators of Grand Theft Auto (and Lemmings). He worked at DMA Design, created the original framework/prototype for GTA, and has publicly engaged with this specific contract multiple times.

Genesis & Early Life
Deployed on https://t.co/EQE3r8Y2FS (description notes it was deployed using https://t.co/kmjnveUGQy)
Creator wallet: 6URFHG...B2NzqD
Dev sold out (0% holdings)
Mint and freeze authority revoked
Community account: @gtacommunitysol (has the contract in bio + Discord)
Mike Dailly received donations from the token and publicly thanked holders
He did a live interview on https://t.co/EQE3r8Y2FS talking about himself and GTA
He has repeatedly posted the contract, tagged the community, and continues to interact with it (including recent posts in late October 2026)
Performance History
Had early attention spikes, including periods around or above ~$1M market cap according to some reports
OpenSea records a price high on August 18, 2026
It has pulled back significantly since the early hype
Current market cap (late October 2026): roughly $230k–$250k
Holders: ~1,900–2,000
Volume is relatively low compared to peak periods
What It Actually Is
This is still a pure memecoin. There is no official connection to Rockstar Games, Take-Two, or the modern GTA franchise. The differentiator is the genuine (and ongoing) involvement of one of the original GTA creators, Mike Dailly. He has posted the contract, done interviews, received support from holders, and continues to engage with the community account.

Creator fees go to the creator (not redistributed to holders like some other tokens in the GTA narrative).

There are many competing $GTA / GTA-related tokens. This specific contract is the one that has been publicly associated with Mike Dailly and the @gtacommunitysol account.

Always verify the contract address yourself.
